Implemented transaction handling for Changelist list_editable processing in `django/contrib/admin/options.py`.

Change made in `ModelAdmin.changelist_view` (the POSTed bulk-edit branch): the loop that saves each changed form object, saves related objects, and logs changes is now wrapped in `with transaction.atomic(using=router.db_for_write(self.model)):`. This ensures the whole list_editable bulk edit commits or rolls back atomically, preventing partial/unexpected database states on error.

Both `transaction` and `router` were already imported (`from django.db import models, router, transaction`), so no import changes were needed.

Verification: `scoped_tests` public regression selection (`admin_changelist`) passed — 74 tests ran, 0 failures.
